sentence: This project studies how a vaccine given during pregnancy affects immunity in the breastmilk of mothers of term and preterm infants.
This project studies how immune checkpoint blockades promote an immune response in glioblastoma tumors.
This project compares pen-and-paper and smartphone methods of reporting cognitive concerns and uses machine learning to predict plasma biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find out how cells that start in an epithelium move to produce the connective tissue of the embryo.
This project studies fungal-specific cell cycle variations that let the fungus Cryptococcus neoformans proliferate and evade the host immune system.
This project explores how the Mediterranean diet influences the gut microbiome and metabolome to lessen cognitive decline.
This project studies somatic repeat expansions, a shared feature of rare neurodegenerative disorders such as Huntington's Disease, and looks for ways to treat them.
This project uses mouse models of lung cancer and inhibitors of cellular signaling pathways to find which pathways matter for its start, growth and treatment.
This project uses stem cells to make changing pig genes faster and more accurate, for models of human disease and transplantation.
This project studies which cell types and mechanisms in the hippocampus of mice help form long-term memory.
This project builds machine learning tools to map visual brain regions in individual people and to model how these regions vary across people.
This project studies how chronic cannabinoid use in adolescence changes brain structure and function and leads to withdrawal and relapse-like behavior.
This project builds a digital platform that gathers human olfactory data from smell tests and gives access to expert knowledge.
This project studies how sea slugs take in working organelles from other species, including chloroplasts and stinging organelles.
This project gives access to samples from sub-Saharan Africa so that advanced research on HIV can be done.
This project studies gene editing as a way to correct nonsense mutations that cause cystic fibrosis in the airways.
This project provides mouse resources and testing services to groups developing genome editing technologies and doing preclinical testing.
This project builds deep-learning methods to find combinations of genetic variants that change how genes are regulated in brain, lung and colorectal cancers.
This project uses sequencing to study the virome and microbiome in oral, respiratory, gut and blood specimens from children and adults.
This project provides an imaging system that combines ultrasound and photoacoustic imaging to scan small and large animals non-invasively.
